purpose: Teach: 払え/堅い/出れ/きつく/貸す/休ま/おかあさん/かわいく

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 修学旅行、自分で払えるお小遣い、貯めてる。
lines.en: I'm saving up my allowance for the school trip.
lines.style: Bright, conversational opening. Natural cadence on 「修学旅行」. Slight lift at the end—enthusiasm without overselling it. Direct and confident.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。試験、堅い問題、多くて、辛い。
lines.en: Yeah. The exam had a lot of really tough questions.
lines.style: Wry, almost rueful. Soft landing on 「辛い」—underplaying the frustration. Eyes slightly rolled inward. Tired laugh underneath.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 朝、布団から出れない時、ある。
lines.en: Sometimes in the morning I just can't get out of bed.
lines.style: Quiet, almost confessional. Slight vulnerability showing through. Measured pace. Trails off slightly on the admission, like she's being honest in a moment of quiet.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 部活、きつくて、毎日へとへと。
lines.en: Club is killing me. I'm wiped out every single day.
lines.style: Subdued, almost flat affect. Heavy emphasis on the exhaustion. Small pause before 「毎日」—like the repetition itself is wearing. Breath slightly tight.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ノート、貸すから、参考にして。
lines.en: I'll lend you my notes. You can use them for the test.
lines.style: Warm but matter-of-fact. No fanfare—just offering, natural as breathing. Gentle tone. This is what friends do. No need to make it a thing.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 今日、半日、休まない、頑張る。
lines.en: I'm pushing through today. No break—just gotta keep going.
lines.style: Quiet determination. Not boasting, just stating the plan. Steady, resolute. A note of resignation beneath the resolve.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: おかあさんが、明日、運動会観に来てくれる。
lines.en: My mom's coming to watch the sports day tomorrow.
lines.style: Animated, genuinely pleased. Brighter attack on the opening. Warmth in the voice—not performing, just happy. Small brightness at the tail.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 入場アナウンス、かわいく聞こえるね。
lines.en: The entrance announcement sounds kind of cute.
lines.style: Gentle observation, almost playful. Soft smile in the voice. Noticing something small and warm. Warm close—easy, genuine.
